name: Interrogator
source:
She is brought in to force Julie to give up all of her passwords and personal information. 

She does this by mercilessly torturing and whipping Julie for the information she wants.

This is done so that Julie's old life can be taken over and destroyed as the criminal organization fully converts Julie's life into that of a sex slave.
